operator_briefing_en: The proposed intervention aims to reduce delays by diverting traffic from Tsuen Wan & Ting Kau to Tuen Mun via Castle Peak Road. Evidence shows a -5% change in delay compared to no action. A tradeoff involves potential increased travel times for alternative routes, so monitor corridor performance. This plan awaits operator review.
operator_briefing_zh: 此提案旨在透過Castle Peak Road將Tsuen Wan & Ting Kau至Tuen Mun的車流進行導引，以減少延誤。相對於不採取額外措施，模擬延誤變化為-5%（保留正負號）。此計畫涉及替代路線的使用，因此需監測走廊表現。此計畫尚待運營商審核。
uncertainty_note_en: Assumes 50% compliance and 59 minutes to clear; lane and timing assumptions require review.
